formPredictionOutcome: PREDICTIONS RECORDED BEFORE BAKES. All four rungs predicted holds_silhouette on the FORM basis: boxy subjects go deep, curved subjects do not. pulse-oximeter is the case the stage was built for (296,226 raw to 25,000 plus a 512 map held at 12.6% under its shipped 80k champion in the hand-run); glucometer is the boxy handheld that held at 25k on FORM grounds. The map shades facets and cannot move a silhouette, so the mapped variant carries the same prediction as the bare one. FORM stands at 3 of 4 after #694; a wrong prediction here is a real miss for the record and fails nothing in this sweep's contract.
